• 数额较大且占应纳税额10%以上：三年以下有期徒刑或拘役，并处罚金

**扣缴义务人**
• 用欺骗手段不缴或少缴已扣税款，同样按上述标准处罚

• 经税务机关下达追缴通知后，补缴税款、滞纳金并接受行政处罚的，可不予追究刑事责任
• 例外：五年内因逃税受过刑事处罚或被税务机关给予二次以上行政处罚的除外

**虚开发票罪（刑法第205条）**
• 虚开增值税专用发票：最高可判无期徒刑
• 虚开普通发票：情节严重的，二年以下有期徒刑；情节特别严重的，二至七年有期徒刑

• If the amount is relatively large AND exceeds 10% of taxes owed: up to 3 years imprisonment or criminal detention, plus a fine

**Withholding Agents**
• Using deceptive means to not pay or underpay withheld taxes — same penalties as above apply

**Circumstances Where Criminal Liability Is Not Pursued**
• If after receiving a recovery notice from tax authorities, you pay back the taxes, late fees, and accept administrative penalties, criminal liability may not be pursued
• Exception: this does NOT apply if you've received criminal punishment for tax evasion or been given administrative penalties by tax authorities two or more times within the past five years

**Invoice Fraud (Criminal Law Article 205)**
• Fraudulently issuing special VAT invoices: max sentence is life imprisonment
• Fraudulently issuing regular invoices: if circumstances are serious, up to 2 years imprisonment; if especially serious, 2 to 7 years imprisonment

酒驾醉驾的法律责任，情报官给您梳理一下 📋

**饮酒驾驶（行政处罚）**
• 血液酒精含量：20-80mg/100ml
• 处罚：暂扣驾照6个月，罚款1000-2000元
• 再犯：拘留10日以下，罚款1000-2000元，吊销驾照

**醉酒驾驶（刑事犯罪）**
• 血液酒精含量：≥80mg/100ml
• 罪名：危险驾驶罪（刑法第133条之一）
• 刑罚：拘役，并处罚金
• 附加：吊销驾照，5年内不得重新取得

**加重情节**
• 造成交通事故且负主要责任：从重处罚
• 血液酒精含量≥200mg/100ml：从重处罚
• 在高速/城市快速路驾驶：从重处罚
• 严重超员、超载或超速：从重处罚
• 无证驾驶：从重处罚

**肇事逃逸**
若醉驾造成重大事故后逃逸，可能构成交通肇事罪，最高可判七年以上有期徒刑

Legal consequences for drink-driving and drunk-driving — your intel officer's got a rundown for you 📋

**Drink-driving (administrative penalty)**
• Blood alcohol level: 20–80mg/100ml
• Penalty: License suspended for 6 months, fine of 1,000–2,000 yuan
• Repeat offense: Up to 10 days detention, fine of 1,000–2,000 yuan, license revoked

**Drunk-driving (criminal offense)**
• Blood alcohol level: ≥80mg/100ml
• Charge: Dangerous driving (Criminal Law Article 133-1)
• Sentence: Criminal detention plus a fine
• Additional: License revoked, cannot reapply for 5 years

**Aggravating circumstances**
• Causing a traffic accident with primary liability: harsher punishment
• Blood alcohol level ≥200mg/100ml: harsher punishment
• Driving on highways/urban expressways: harsher punishment
• Serious overloading of passengers, cargo, or speeding: harsher punishment
• Driving without a license: harsher punishment

**Hit-and-run**
If drunk-driving causes a major accident and the driver flees the scene, it could constitute the crime of causing a traffic accident, with a maximum sentence of seven years or more in prison
